Its nominated single-occurrence descent branch can be retained as a unified process only, not as instantaneous or once-only arrival.

The exact 17:98 surface supplies crumbling, raising, creation, and newness around the focus partition. The transfer to renewed textual encounter is retained as an attributed analogy, with the resurrection reading left intact.

The focus distribution and repeated conveying meet 17:100's exact treasury, withholding, expenditure, and constriction surfaces. The contrastive release reading survives as legacy-attributed contextual evidence, not as an asserted divine motive.

The focus distinction and placement branches meet the pericope's clear signs, disclosed knowledge, insight-signs, and repeated truthful descent. Each contextual branch has a matching supplied coordinate and returns to the focus; its pedagogical fit remains attributed.

The focus's public audience and divided text meet the supplied sequence of attempted destabilization, dwelling, and mixed arrival. The social-gathering reading is retained as an attributed analogy, not as a claim that the historical sequence describes recitation's effects.

The focus's descent and recitation return through the supplied 17:107 and 17:109 sequence of recitation, falling, prostration, and increased humility. The relation is contextual and does not make every hearer respond.

The measured-reading carrier meets 17:110's supplied opposed vocal limits and sought middle path. This adds a bounded acoustic analogy while preserving the live possibility that 17:110 governs prayer independently.

The doubled focus descent construction and the closing speech-plus-magnification construction supply an exact, surprising compositional echo. The reading remains rhetorical and exploratory, not causal or grammatical equivalence.

findings.title: Differentiated Delivery Fitted to Waiting
findings.claim: The focus presents one recitable Qur'an apportioned into discernible portions, read over a human audience across measured time, and conveyed in stages. Within the pericope, truthful descent before it and embodied reception after it let that interval read as a mode of encounter with an intact source.
findings.mechanism: The q-r-ء carrier names the recitable object and the act of reciting it; the independent f-r-q clause distinguishes and distributes its portions, while al-nās supplies a public audience and m-k-th supplies duration and composed pacing. The n-z-l pair carries divine delivery. The preceding truthful descent and following recitation-response sequence contact these focus carriers, changing division from neutral formatting into an articulated, receivable delivery process.
findings.reader_payoff: Unity and segmentation remain visible together: each portion can be heard over time, and the nearby response scene shows reception moving into posture and increasing humility.
findings.containment: This does not claim equal portions, universal audience response, or an instantaneous descent. The single-occurrence facet is held as one encompassing delivery process across stages; it does not cancel the focus's explicit division, pacing, and staged-conveying language.

epistemic.reason: The channel sources are marked trusted and the focus word-to-QAC bridge resolves 11/11 words. The unified-process reading of the single-occurrence facet is a bounded contextual interpretation.

findings.claim: The pericope's claim that crumbled remains can be raised as a new creation opens a bounded analogy for the focus's portions: textual division need not entail loss of the gathered whole, because each recited portion can renew an encounter with it.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries partition and an attributed gathered-recitation branch. The independent 17:98 sequence moves from crumbled remains through being raised to creation as new. That destruction-and-renewal sequence contacts the divided recitation and changes partition from neutral formatting into a reversible reception analogy.
findings.reader_payoff: A portion can be encountered as part of a whole that remains available, rather than as debris left behind.
findings.containment: The context remains about resurrection. This analogy does not equate textual portions with bones, claim that recitation is re-creation, or replace the focus's explicit division and delivery.

epistemic.reason: All HFT branch roles are legacy_unbound, although their 17:98 roots and word indices match the exact supplied Arabic. The transfer from resurrection to textual reception is explicitly an inference.

findings.reader_payoff: The stages can be perceived as a form of giving that remains available over time, not as evidence that the source is being guarded from its recipients.
findings.containment: 17:100 diagnoses human avarice but does not state that it explains the divine delivery in 17:106. The contrast is attributed and does not claim every interval answers human withholding.

epistemic.reason: The exact 17:100 roots and coordinates match the supplied surface, while the movement from human hoarding to the focus's delivery logic is an HFT-attributed contextual inference.
